entities.name: Jacob Hauken
entities.description: A human geist-talker and detective from Nephalia, Innistrad, who can see geists and investigates geist-related incidents; raised by the Vizag Atum.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Jacob works as an investigator of strange occurrences.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Region of Innistrad Jacob Hauken is from.

entities.name: Vizag Atum
entities.description: The group that raised Jacob; its members have special powers.

entities.name: Eloise Wicker
entities.description: Jacob's temporary partner, later hired by Cyril Rav.

entities.name: Lord Nellick
entities.description: A lord who hired Jacob to investigate a roving geist; later possessed by Cyril Rav.

entities.name: Cyril Rav
entities.description: A necro-alchemist who died in a misfired geistbomb and as a geist possessed living bodies, including Lord Nellick.

entities.name: Millicent
entities.description: Leader of the ghosts misused in the geistbomb, who haunted Rav for revenge.

entities.name: Alrun River
entities.description: River near the township where the roving geist attacked people.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: An event on Innistrad before which Hauken and Eloise worked together.

events.summary: Jacob leaves the Vizag Atum after a friend is murdered and the group does not want to find the culprit.
events.quote: left the group after a friend of his was murdered and the group was not interested in finding the culprit

events.summary: Three years later Hauken and Eloise are hired by Lord Nellick to investigate a roving geist near the Alrun River.
events.quote: rejoined three years later when they were hired by Lord Nellick to investigate a roving geist

events.summary: Rav, in the form of Lord Nellick, discovers Hauken has the Vizag Atum's powers and offers a partnership, which Hauken accepts; they vanish leaving bodies behind.
events.quote: He offered Hauken an unusual partnership, which Hauken accepted.

relations.quote: Rav - in the form of Lord Nellick
He offered Hauken an unusual partnership, which Hauken accepted.
Hauken and his temporary partner Eloise Wicker worked together before the Travails
